question: ______ is a type of single thin sheet of metal that yields when pressure is applied and is widely used in most modern cars. When pressure is removed, the metal springs back to its original shape.
solution:
The correct answer is __Diaphragm spring.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Diaphragm spring__ is a type of single thin sheet of metal.
 
• It yields when pressure is applied and is widely used in most modern cars.
 
• When pressure is removed, the metal springs back to its original shape.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Leaf spring:**

 
 
• It is a simple form of spring used mainly for suspension in vehicles.
 
• It consists of multiple layers (leaves) of metal bound together.
 
 
 
• **Cushion spring:**
 
 
• It is designed to absorb shocks and vibrations.
 
• It is commonly used in furniture and seating applications.
 
 
 
• **Spiral spring:**
 
 
• It is a spring made in the form of a coil or spiral.
 
• It is used in clocks, watches, and other small mechanisms.
